title: Smallest Missing Non Negative Integer After Operations
statement:
Given an integer array `nums` and positive integer `value`, an operation adds or subtracts `value` from one element. Return the greatest MEX (smallest missing non-negative integer) achievable after any number of operations.

## Examples

```text
Input: nums = [1, -10, 7, 13, 6, 8], value = 5
Output: 4
```

```text
Input: nums = [1, -10, 7, 13, 6, 8], value = 7
Output: 2
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= nums.length, value <= 10^5`
- `-10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9`
